edits.why: Load the maude-v2 tokens instead of maude. Every token the canvas and RepoBranchSwitcher.css use exists in maude-v2 under the same name.
Use the maude-v2 shared component styles.
Artboard A: maude-v2's tokens are scoped to .maude-v2[data-theme]; light is its default theme.

notes: maude-v2 has no .panel or .tree-row; the sidebar and file tree use them and will render unstyled until restyled with maude-v2 parts (.island, .row-item) or added to RepoBranchSwitcher.css.

The draft state is drawn in amber. In maude-v2 colour is functional (azure = action/selection, vermilion = AI only), so check the amber draft chip still reads right; --status-warn is the nearest token.
The theme goes from dark to light. Use data-theme="dark" instead if the dark look should stay.
The comments in RepoBranchSwitcher.css still name system/maude.
